calls.statement:
SELECT p.category, p.subcategory, r.reason_code, count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) units, min(r.return_date) mn, max(r.return_date) mx
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND (p.category ILIKE '%garden%' OR p.subcategory ILIKE '%furniture%')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.*, p.sku, cp.category cur_cat, cp.subcategory cur_sub, p.subcategory ver_sub, s.store_id,
         f.quantity sold_qty, f.sale_date, f.product_key sale_pk,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) hel_date
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' OR p.subcategory='Garden Furniture'
)
SELECT
 count(*) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') n_rd,
 sum(quantity_returned) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') u_rd,
 sum(quantity_returned) filter (where hel_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') u_hel,
 sum(quantity_returned) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' and ver_sub='Garden Furniture') u_ver,
 count(distinct return_line_id) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') n_dist,
 count(*) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' and store_id IN (999)) n999,
 count(*) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' and store_id=900) n900,
 count(*) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' and sold_qty is null) n_nosale,
 count(*) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' and quantity_returned>sold_qty) n_over,
 count(*) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' and quantity_returned<=0) n_nonpos,
 count(*) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' and return_date<sale_date) n_before,
 count(*) filter (where return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' and cur_cat<>'Garden') n_notgarden
FROM base

calls.statement:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.return_line_id, r.sales_line_id, r.return_date, r.quantity_returned, r.refund_net, r.reason_code, s.store_id, f.quantity sold_qty, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, f.staff_purchase_flag,
         w.status, w.fulfilment_type, w.dispatch_ts_utc
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
)
SELECT status, fulfilment_type, store_id=900 is_web_store, count(*) n, sum(quantity_returned) u,
  count(*) - count(distinct sales_line_id) dup_lines, min(sale_date) mnsale, max(sale_date) mxsale,
  sum(case when refund_net<=0 then 1 else 0 end) nonpos_refund,
  sum(case when dispatch_ts_utc is null then 1 else 0 end) nodispatch
FROM base GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT r.return_date d, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) v, count(*) n, count(distinct r.return_line_id) nd
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2),
b AS (SELECT business_date d, store_id, returns_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<>999)
SELECT (SELECT sum(v) FROM a) fact_total, (SELECT sum(returns_net) FROM b) rpt_total, (SELECT sum(n) FROM a) nlines, (SELECT sum(nd) FROM a) ndist,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT a.d FROM a FULL JOIN b USING (d,store_id) WHERE abs(coalesce(a.v,0)-coalesce(b.returns_net,0))>0.01)) mismatches,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) multi_return_lines,
 (SELECT fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) loaded

calls.statement:
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
GROUP BY ALL
